# Curated gamedev skills

Source: [awesome-gamedev-agent-skills](https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills), commit **184b72be02884f782a0058f2eeae2ce4277453e4**, retrieved and verified **2026-10-24**.

This package contains 18 selected skill directories: `create-game-assets`, `threejs-scene-setup`, `threejs-gltf-loading`, `threejs-materials-lighting`, `performance-optimization`, `game-feel`, `audio-design`, `game-ui-ux`, `camera-systems`, `physics-tuning`, `procedural-gen`, `shader-programming`, `level-design`, `input-systems`, `save-systems`, `game-ai`, `prototype-fast`, and `router`. The pinned upstream tree contains 76 specialized skills plus the router. The curated package copies every file within each selected directory, including its references, assets, scripts and agent metadata when present.

License: [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). The upstream [NOTICE](NOTICE) is included unchanged. Every copied file was checked against its upstream Git blob hash. **Local content modifications: none.** Packaging changes: upstream `skills/<category>/<name>/` directories were placed at `<name>/`; `router/` retains its name. This README is local packaging documentation, not an upstream file. Upstream paths shown inside the unchanged router describe the full repository: use the local routing map below to locate bundled skills. Skills outside this subset are not silently available.

Load the narrowest relevant skill using [the DevFridge routing table](../../references/gamedev-skills.md). Game-specific owner decisions and DevFridge wallet, access, Store, disclosure and evidence rules take precedence over general upstream advice. Loading a vendored skill does not authorize sending messages, publishing, installing dependencies or signing transactions beyond the user's task scope.

For other engines or genres, use the [upstream installation guide at the pinned commit](https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills/blob/184b72be02884f782a0058f2eeae2ce4277453e4/docs/INSTALLATION.md). A reproducible manual installation downloads that commit and copies each immediate parent of `SKILL.md`, plus `router/`, into the host's configured skill directory. Keep references and license notices with the package. Inspect an existing destination before copying; do not overwrite unrelated skills. The upstream convenience command `npx skills add gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills` installs the current upstream version, not necessarily this pinned snapshot; review its version and installation scope first. Read the full pack's engine baseline before changing an established game's engine or dependencies.
